# Tuesday, 15 September 2026

**Markets:** Dalal Street reopens after Monday's Ganesh Chaturthi holiday into a hostile setup — Brent near $109, the US 10-year through 5% for the first time since 2023, and Wall Street down on AI-slowdown fears; last Indian close (Fri) had Sensex off 121 pts with Nifty just under 23,400.
**Non-market:** The BRICS summit closed in New Delhi with the New Delhi Declaration and 50+ deliverables under India's chairship, while Mumbai police refused Manoj Jarange's Azad Maidan hunger-strike permission for a second time.

## Top 3 today

**1. US 10-year Treasury yield tops 5% — first time since 2023 — two days before the Fed decides**
A global bond selloff pushed the benchmark through 5% intraday Monday before it pared back, with some traders now pricing a Fed *hike* rather than a cut as oil-driven inflation bites. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/14/10-year-us-treasury-is-closing-in-on-5percent.html), [Invezz](https://invezz.com/news/2026/09/14/us-10-year-yield-tops-5-as-markets-price-fed-hike/))
Watch: a hawkish hold or a hike lands mid-week into an Indian market already seeing FPI outflows and a record-low rupee — the INR and the 10-year G-sec are where it transmits first.

**2. Oil near $109–110 as the Strait of Hormuz crisis runs into its 200th day**
UKMTO confirmed another vessel struck in the Strait, Oman postponed the Iran talks, and Brent has held above $100 for weeks. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/13/vessel-struck-strait-of-hormuz-ukmto.html), [FinanceFeeds](https://financefeeds.com/brent-crude-oil-price-107-oman-postpones-iran-hormuz-talks/), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/6/us-iran-engaged-in-tanker-war-where-is-the-months-long-conflict-headed))
Watch: this is the single biggest line item in India's macro right now — it feeds the trade deficit, the rupee and the CPI print that just rose for a tenth straight month. Situation still moving.

**3. Anthropic, OpenAI and xAI leaders call for a slowdown in AI development — chipmakers take the hit**
Dario Amodei proposed a plan to slow the pace of frontier capability gains, with Sam Altman, Elon Musk and Google's AI chief broadly agreeing; Micron fell ~5% and Nvidia, AMD and Intel followed. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/12/anthropics-amodei-proposes-plan-to-slow-the-pace-of-advancing-ai-capabilities.html), [Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/09/12/anthropic-ai-amodei-pacing), [Reuters via Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/ai-warnings-knock-nasdaq-futures-092329455.html))
Watch: the awkward part is that Anthropic is simultaneously prepping a Nasdaq IPO — if a slowdown consensus holds, the capex assumption underpinning the whole semis complex is what reprices, not just sentiment.

## Indian markets & macro

**Markets reopen today after the Ganesh Chaturthi holiday** — NSE, BSE and MCX were shut Monday 14 September. ([Business Today](https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/stocks/story/stock-market-holiday-why-nse-bse-will-remain-closed-on-september-14-555318-2026-09-14))
Last print was Friday: Sensex settled 121 pts lower, Nifty a shade below 23,400.

**Friday's close: Sensex −121 pts, Nifty just under 23,400, Bank Nifty a rare gainer.** ([Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/markets/capital-market-news/sensex-settles-121-pts-lower-nifty-ends-tad-below-23-400-level-126091100824_1.html), [5paisa](https://www.5paisa.com/blog/post-market-update-us-futures-gain-nifty-sensex-lower-bank-nifty-gains-september-11-2026))
Oil and war headlines have been the dominant driver for several sessions now, not domestic data.

**August CPI at 4.82% — inflation has risen for ten straight months.** ([The Tribune](https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/consumer-prices/cpi-inflation-in-august-at-4-82-yoy-led-by-food-inflation), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/14/india-inflation-august-iran-war-energy-el-nino.html))
Food-led, with imported energy and El Niño both in the mix — it narrows the MPC's room considerably.

**Q1 FY27 GDP came in at 7.8%, above the RBI's 7% forecast.** ([PIB](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2026/sep/doc_9759_20260901_14422101.pdf), [IBTimes](https://www.ibtimes.sg/india-gdp-growth-hits-7-8-q1-fy27-economists-question-what-data-misses))
Strong headline, but several economists have flagged what the deflator and the nominal-vs-real gap may be hiding.

**FPIs have pulled ₹13,138 crore from Indian equities in September after July–August inflows.** ([Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/fpis-withdraw-13-138-crore-from-equities-in-sep-amid-global-uncertainty-126091300134_1.html), [The Federal](https://thefederal.com/category/business/foreign-investors-pull-out-rs-13138-cr-from-indian-equities-in-sept-after-jul-aug-inflows-256497))
With the US 10-year at 5%, the relative-yield case for EM equity gets harder every week.

**Rupee at a record low despite more than $15 billion of RBI intervention.** ([Angel One](https://www.angelone.in/news/economy/rupee-falls-to-record-low-despite-rbi-intervention-of-over-15-billion), [InvestingLive](https://investinglive.com/forex/rupee-nears-record-low-as-rbi-intervenes-but-oil-risk-aversion-weigh))
Reserves being spent to smooth, not defend a level — worth watching the weekly reserves data.

**Stocks to watch today: HDFC Bank, HFCL, Emami, Coforge, Solar Industries, Vodafone Idea.** ([Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/stocks-to-watch-september-15-hdfc-bank-hfcl-emami-coforge-solar-inds-vodafone-idea-126091500081_1.html))
HDFC Bank added roughly ₹28,000 crore of market cap last week, outpacing the Adani group. ([IIFL](https://www.indiainfoline.com/news/business/hdfc-bank-outpaces-adani-group-with-28000-crore-market-cap-boost))

MEA counts 50+ concrete outcomes under India's chairship, with Global South priorities the framing device.

**Mumbai under a rain alert, with the Maratha protest and blast-case hearings running alongside.** ([LatestLY](https://www.latestly.com/india/news/mumbai-latest-news-today-on-september-14th-2026-rain-alert-maratha-protest-blast-case-updates-7603385.html))

**Chipmakers led the fall — Micron −5%, with Nvidia, AMD and Intel down.** ([Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/coverage/stock-market-today/2026/09/14/stock-market-midday-sept-14-tech-stocks-slide-on-dire-ai-warnings-micron-drops-5/), [Yahoo](https://ca.finance.yahoo.com/news/ai-warning-sends-nvidia-amd-190909953.html))

**The Fed meets this week with oil, AI and inflation all pulling in different directions.** ([US News](https://www.usnews.com/news/national-news/articles/2026-09-14/fed-meets-amid-uncertainty-over-oil-ai-and-inflation))
The bond market has moved from "when do they cut" to "might they hike" inside a fortnight.

**Global bond selloff, not just a US story — yields rose across major markets.** ([Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-09-11/global-bond-selloff-sends-10-year-treasury-yields-to-cusp-of-5))
Duration is being repriced everywhere; term premium is back as a live variable.

**Hormuz traffic down sharply even as the US insists the waterway is "fully open".** ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/9/7/iran-war-live-tehran-to-announce-new-hormuz-shipping-route-in-coming-days))

# Monday, 14 September 2026

**Markets:** Dalal Street is shut for Ganesh Chaturthi after Friday closed near three-month lows — Sensex down 121 pts, Nifty just under 23,400 — with Brent above $108 and the 10-year US yield knocking on 5%.
**Off-market:** Saudi Arabia has shut the East-West pipeline that bypasses the Strait of Hormuz after a drone attack, and an Indian-crewed tanker was hit off Oman with one seafarer still missing.

---

## Top 3 today

**1. Saudi pipeline shut, oil punches through $108**
Riyadh closed the East-West crude line — the one artery that lets Gulf barrels skip the Strait of Hormuz — after a drone strike, and a fresh attack near Qeshm Island killed one crew member on an Iranian vessel. Brent settled at $108.03 (+3.27%), WTI at $103.42 (+3.37%), with Business Standard flagging a scenario where roughly 4% of global supply goes offline.
*What to watch:* India imports ~85% of its crude, so this runs straight into the CAD, the rupee (95.57/$) and OMC marketing margins — HPCL is called out as the most exposed. Every extra $10 on Brent is the single biggest variable in the RBI's October MPC call. [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/energy/2026/09/14/oil-nears-108-after-saudi-arabia-shuts-pipeline-amid-attacks) · [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/12/saudi-arabia-shuts-critical-oil-pipeline-after-drone-attack-what-happened)

**2. Fed week, and the G7 is hiking, not cutting**
The FOMC decides Wednesday with market-implied odds of a 25bp *hike* at 85–90% after August US CPI printed 3.4%. The ECB already moved on 10 September, lifting rates to 2.5% — Lagarde called it a "no brainer" — and the BoE and BoJ follow later in the week. Treasury Secretary Bessent is reportedly weighing intervention to stop the 10-year clearing 5% (it closed at 4.982%).
*What to watch:* A synchronised G7 tightening into an energy shock is the 1970s playbook running in reverse order. For India it compresses the rate differential, pressures the rupee, and makes the RBI's ₹1 trn liquidity drain look like pre-positioning rather than housekeeping. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/31/markets-see-warsh-endorsing-a-rate-hike-in-september.html) · [CNBC — ECB](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/10/ecb-interest-rate-hike-lagarde-iran.html)

**3. RBI forces the Tata Sons listing question**
The Reserve Bank has rejected Tata Sons' application to surrender its Core Investment Company registration — the manoeuvre that would have let it avoid a mandatory listing. The board meets on 17 September to take up both the IPO and the group's top leadership in the same sitting.
*What to watch:* This would be the largest listing India has ever seen, and it arrives bundled with a succession question at the holdco. Watch Tata Sons' listed subsidiaries — the market has historically priced a Tata Sons IPO as a re-rating event for the whole group. [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/tata-sons-to-take-up-top-leadership-ipo-issues-on-sep-17-after-rbi-missive-126091300858_1.html) · [Moneylife](https://www.moneylife.in/)

**Wall Street rallied into the Fed** — S&P 500 7,656.98 (+0.86%), Dow 52,573.29 (+0.98%), Nasdaq 26,333.04 (+0.96%), VIX down 11.2% to 15.84. Stocks are pricing a hike they think is already survivable. [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news)

**US 10-year at 4.982%, 30-year at 5.367%** — and Bessent is reportedly weighing intervention if the long end clears 5%. That threshold is now a policy line, not just a chart level. [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news)

**Gold slipped to $4,369/oz (−0.90%), silver to $64.39 (−1.23%)** — an odd divergence from the war premium in crude, and worth watching as a tell on whether the oil move is read as supply-shock or escalation. [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news)

**Indonesian ferry capsizes in the Java Sea: 6 dead, about 130 missing** from roughly 240 aboard, with 107 rescued. Search operations continue; numbers still moving. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/13/one-dead-102-rescued-after-indonesian-ferry-goes-missing-in-java-sea)

**India supplied 70% of Russia's oil product imports in August**, including 120,000 tonnes of gasoline, as Ukrainian strikes knock out Russian refining. A strange inversion of the usual trade, and a sanctions headache in waiting. [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/world-news)

**India–EU FTA heads to the EU Council; signing expected in December** — the Commission calls it the largest trade agreement either side has ever concluded. [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/economy/news/india-eu-fta-heads-to-eu-council-for-approval-signing-likely-in-december-126091101402_1.html)

## AI, tech & science

**Amodei calls for slowing the frontier — and Altman and Musk back him** — a three-step pacing plan from Anthropic's CEO, endorsed by two rivals, which is itself the news. Trump rejected it flatly: "whoever wins with AI wins." Chip stocks wobbled; Business Standard notes the underlying compute demand looks intact. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/12/anthropic-ceo-outlines-plan-to-pace-the-frontier/) · [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/technology/tech-news/why-altman-musk-and-amodei-want-to-slow-the-ai-race-126091400087_1.html)

**Human heart muscle regrows after a heart attack — shown for the first time** — overturning the assumption that post-infarct cardiac damage is permanent. If it replicates, it reframes an entire treatment field. [ScienceDaily](https://www.sciencedaily.com/)

**DeepMind's AlphaGenome maps the effects of ~9 billion possible human genetic mutations** — a variant-effect atlas at a scale no wet lab could reach, and the most consequential AI-for-biology result of the week. [Nature](https://www.nature.com/news)

**Modified bone-marrow cells rebuild bone in osteoporosis patients** in a small early trial — promising, but small-n and early; treat the effect size with care until a larger cohort reports. [Nature](https://www.nature.com/news)

**DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash claims to beat GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Opus 5 on price-performance** at $0.003 per 1M cached input tokens off-peak. The claim is the lab's own and unaudited — but the pricing, if real, is the competitive story. [VentureBeat](https://venturebeat.com/category/ai/)

**KAIST's "chameleon" chip cuts AI prediction errors up to 40-fold** by adapting to varying data speeds — a hardware answer to a problem usually thrown at models. [Phys.org](https://phys.org/)

**Quantum error detection gets a cleaner primitive** — a two-qubit entangling gate that flags its own failures as detectable photon losses, alongside separate work quadrupling microscope resolution with entangled photons. [Phys.org](https://phys.org/)

# Daily Digest — Sunday, 13 September 2026

**Tone:** Risk-off into the weekend — oil's war premium, a rupee at 95.80 and a US 10-year near 4.97% have markets pricing a Fed *hike*, not a cut, before Wednesday's FOMC.

## Indian markets & macro

**Nifty ends the week at 23,398, Sensex 74,782 — realty leads the slide.** Friday closed -0.34% / -0.16%; Nifty Realty fell 2.70% to 848.50, now down 7.6% over six sessions (Godrej Properties -6.6%, Lodha -4.6%). IT was the only real bid. Breadth negative: 2,018 up vs 2,470 down. [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/markets/capital-market-news/sensex-settles-121-pts-lower-nifty-ends-tad-below-23-400-level-126091100824_1.html)

**Rupee sheds 1.21% on the week to 95.80/$.** Three drivers stacking up: MCX crude +11% on the week, US 10-year near 4.95%, and August US PPI at 5.4% y/y lifting Fed hike odds. The worst possible mix for an oil importer. [FXStreet](https://www.fxstreet.com/news/indian-rupee-extends-decline-on-fresh-escalation-in-hawkish-fed-bets-202609110534)

**RBI signals it has more than VRRR in the toolkit.** Governor Sanjay Malhotra said the bank will keep "appropriate liquidity" and can lean on OMOs or FX swaps. Context: the last verified CPI print is July at 4.45%, the highest since December 2024, driven by exactly the energy and transport channel now reheating. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/05/india-rbi-interest-rate-inflation-iran-war.html)

## India — national

**BRICS summit wraps in New Delhi; Modi tells Xi border peace is "essential."** The 18th summit ran 12–13 Sept at Bharat Mandapam with Xi, Putin, Pezeshkian, Sisi and Ramaphosa. The New Delhi Declaration condemned the Pahalgam attack and backed "zero tolerance" on terrorism; no fresh India–China deliverables were reported. [The Week](https://www.theweek.in)

**Satya Niketan building collapse: death toll rises to seven, three arrested.** The Delhi PG-block collapse near DU has killed seven with several injured; police arrested the building owner and two others, and the High Court held DU and the MCD partly responsible. Figures are still being confirmed. [Outlook](https://www.outlookindia.com/national/delhi-building-collapse-live-satya-niketan-rescue-operation)
